references.text: Jethro advised Moses that he could not carry the people's burden alone, which led to the appointment of judges
Moses complains to the Lord that he cannot bear the entire people's burden alone, and the Lord commands him to gather seventy elders
The account of how Moses organized leadership in Israel with the help of judges to share the burden
Moses asks how he can alone carry the people's burden, toil, and disputes - an elaboration on the same theme
The solution to Moses' challenge - he took the heads of the tribes and appointed them as leaders over the people
